events.title: 맨체스터 유나이티드's two-year unbeaten Premier League home run is ended by a 2–1 defeat against 첼시.

블랙번 로버스 achieve their first league win over the season in style by beating 리버풀 3–0 at Ewood Park , with two goals from a resurgent Chris Sutton . On the same day, Peter Beardsley also appears on the scoresheet twice – as 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 beat local rivals 미들즈브러 3–1 to boost their own title challenge and push their opponents further towards the relegation zone.
Dutch striker Bryan Roy is put on the transfer list at £2 million by Premier League strugglers 노팅엄 포리스트.
Tommy Lawton , the former 에버턴 and England forward, dies of pneumonia at age 77.
Phil Neal replaces 맨체스터 시티 manager 스티브 코펠 as caretaker, to be succeeded by Frank Clark on December 29.
스티브 코펠 resigns after 33 days as manager of 맨체스터 시티. 첼시 sign Italy striker 잔프랑코 졸라 from 파르마 for £4.5 million.
Robbie Fowler scores four times as 리버풀 crush 미들즈브러 5–1 at Anfield .

레스터 시티's sound return to the Premier League continues as they beat midlands rivals 애스턴 빌라 3–1 in the league at Villa Park . 에버턴's flagging start to the season is given a much-needed boost as they thrash 사우샘프턴 7–1 at Goodison Park. 게리 스피드 scores a hat-trick, while 안드레이 칸첼스키스 scores twice. Graham Stuart and Nick Barmby score the other goals. 맨체스터 유나이티드's three-match losing streak in the league ends when a 나이절 윈터번 own goal gives them a 1–0 win over 아스널 at Old Trafford.
테리 베너블스 , who quit as England manager last summer, accepts an offer to take charge of the Australia national football team, but insists that he will continue in his role as 포츠머스 chairman.
Queen's Park 레인저스 pay £2.5 million (a record for a club outside the top flight) for 첼시 striker John Spencer .
Conference side Woking shock Division Two 밀월 in the FA Cup third round replay at The Den which followed a 2–2 draw in the first game.
코번트리 시티 pay 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 £1 million for 20-year-old striker Darren Huckerby .

Another FA Cup first round replay upset sees Brighton & Hove Albion (currently bottom of Division Three only six seasons after they almost won promotion to the top flight) lose at home on penalties to non-league Sudbury Town after a 1–1 draw at the Goldstone Ground . However, Whitby Town are not so lucky as they crash to a Duane Darby double hat-trick in the 8–4 defeat to 헐 시티 that followed a goalless draw in the original game.
유벤투스 wins the Intercontinental Cup in FC 도쿄 after defeating Argentina's 리버 플레이트 1–0. The match's only goal is scored by Alessandro del Piero in the 81st minute.

아스널 remain top of the league as November draws to a close, with 뉴캐슬 유나이티드, 리버풀, 윔블던 and 맨체스터 유나이티드 not far behind. 노팅엄 포리스트 are now bottom with still only one win from their opening 15 games, while 코번트리 시티 join them in the bottom three along with a 블랙번 로버스 side who this month finally recorded their first two wins of the league campaign. A 미들즈브러 side featuring some of the country's most expensively signed players are just above the relegation zone as midway point approaches during a season where they had been expected to challenge much higher in the table. 볼턴 원더러스 are still top of Division One, now accompanied in the automatic promotion places by 크리스털 팰리스. Occupying the playoff zone are 반즐리, 노리치 시티, 셰필드 유나이티드 and 트랜미어 로버스.
